entities.name: François de Rovérié de Cabrières
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: François-Marie-Anatole de Rovérié de Cabrières was a French Cardinal of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as Bishop of Montpellier from 1874 until his death, and was elevated to the cardinalate in 1911.
